summary: Created RabinovichNegation.lean with sorry-free depth-0 backward direction and sorry at depth k+1. Provides nf_2var_exist_formula_prior_neg as drop-in for NfCharFormula.lean sorry.

sorry_inventory.assumption: The backward direction of nf_exist_formula at depth k+1 holds on Prior structures
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: Requires arity-climbing induction: depth-k arity-3 existentials need depth-(k-1) arity-4 existentials, etc. This is the full Rabinovich Proposition 4.2 negation closure argument.
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: Implement generalized nf_exist_characterizable for arbitrary arity by strong induction on depth k. At each depth, characterize arity-(n+1) existentials using arity-n characterizations at depth k-1.

blockers: Backward direction of nf_exist_formula at depth k+1 requires encoding depth-k arity-3 existentials as temporal formulas. These involve conditions with 2 free variables (x and t) that cannot be directly encoded as 1-free-variable temporal formulas without the arity-climbing induction.

continuation_context.key_insight: The depth k+1 case needs: for each ssn : NormalForm sig k' 3, encode '∃ y, nf_eval_nf M k' 3 (y,x,t) ssn' as a temporal formula at x. This requires recursively characterizing higher-arity existentials at lower depths.
